svg.text: What a run looks at before it opens the pull request: the new unit large, in every frame and size, beside the three looks it is closest to.
looks: bog_witch is 79% alike to apprentice (limit 75%). Change the outline, not the details: give it a different top, or cut a face into it.
The message the first try got. The second try is a hood with a face cut out of it, and passes.
